Lara (People Ops): Heads-up — Diego submitted his resignation, last day Fri 2026-03-26. We need final pay calculations, COBRA timing, laptop pickup, license reassignments, and SSO deprovision plan. Who can own each piece?
Miguel (IT): I can own device collection + SSO. Quick Q: is Diego fully remote APAC? need to consider courier windows.
Lara (People Ops): Yes APAC (Singapore). Payroll: confirm proration rules and final paycheck timing so we can coordinate.
Payroll Bot: I can do final pay. Need termination date (2026-03-26) and any outstanding PTO to include. Standard cutoff: payroll run 2026-03-30 for March pay; exception if urgent.
Sam (Eng): We rely on a couple of his infra scripts — can we snapshot his repos and set read-only for 30 days? Engineering to request repo-admin snapshot.
Miguel (IT): Plan suggestion: staggered deprovision so we don't break running jobs. Proposal: wave 1 = revoke active sessions + remove token access at employee EOD (23:59 local on last day). wave 2 = disable SSO account after 48h. Courier picks laptop within 72h. Snippet:```
# deprov plan
wave1: kick sessions -> 2026-03-26 23:59 UTC
wave2: disable account -> 2026-03-28 23:59 UTC
courier-pickup window -> 2026-03-29 to 2026-03-31 (SGT)
```
Lara (People Ops): COBRA note: benefits end = last day of month of termination by policy; COBRA notice autogenerated next business day (we send electronically + paper if requested). For Diego (term 3/26) benefits continue through 3/31, COBRA window starts 2026-04-01.
Miguel (IT): For license reassignment: list of seats to free? Diego has: JetBrains (seat), Slack, Datadog, GCP-project editor. Please confirm owners so I can revoke and reassign.
Sam (Eng): Confirmed: engineering will take GCP-project owner transfer request today (filed). Keep service accounts intact until 48h after wave1. We need read-only repo access for 30 days.
Lara (People Ops): I'll schedule exit interview Mon 3/22 and confirm PTO payout amount. Also will ask Diego whether he wants COBRA paper mailed.
CourierBot: Scheduled pickup created — ETA 2026-03-30 10:00 SGT, tracking will be posted here when booked. :truck:
Miguel (IT): I'll post the final deprovision ticket with the exact timestamps and a rollback plan. Tagging people-ops and payroll.
Lara (People Ops): Owners: Miguel = device + SSO deprov (wave plan), Payroll Bot = final pay + PTO, Sam = repo snapshot + GCP transfer, Lara = exit interview + COBRA notice. If no objections, proceed. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): :thumbsup: all good from eng.
Miguel (IT): Starting prep now, will post ticket in ~30m with commands and IP allowlist removal steps.
Lara (People Ops): Thanks team — I'll update Diego's offboard doc and add checklist items (laptop label, courier address, COBRA opt-in).
